## Summary

<!-- What does this change and why? -->

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature or voice command
- [ ] Refactor / chore
- [ ] Documentation

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run typecheck`, `npm run lint` and `npm test` pass
- [ ] New behaviour has unit tests (commands and shared code need >= 80% coverage)
- [ ] No secrets, models or binaries are committed
- [ ] Animations use transforms/opacity and respect `prefers-reduced-motion`
- [ ] Docs / CHANGELOG updated where relevant
